purpose: Teach: 端子/ボルト/区画/キャップ/ポンプ/累積/買取/格納

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、端子の品質を最重視しろ
lines.en: Make terminal quality our absolute priority.
lines.style: Direct, clipped authority. Each word lands with intention. Lean forward slightly on the command. No softness, no negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ボルトの規格を統一しております
lines.en: Yes. We've standardized the bolt specifications across production.
lines.style: Measured confirmation. Slight professional formality—he's reporting upward. Steady eye contact, calm hands. The tone of someone prepared for this question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新たな販売区画を確保しろ
lines.en: Secure new sales territory for the company.
lines.style: Sharp, decisive instruction. Jaw set slightly. Pace is brisk, no room for drift. The voice of someone who expects this done without excuses.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品のキャップ部品を発注しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already placed the order for the product cap components.
lines.style: Quick, efficient. A small note of readiness—he's stayed one step ahead. Professional warmth, not deferential. The quiet confidence of someone who knows what to do.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ポンプの製造ラインを増やせ
lines.style: Flat, non-negotiable instruction. Delivered as fact, not request. A slight pause before speaking, as if settling his authority in the room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の累積残業を確認しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm monitoring the accumulated overtime hours across the team.
lines.style: Careful, responsible tone. Slightly slower—he's flagging something important. Not alarm, but the controlled cadence of someone watching a number that matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 中古品の買取事業を強化しろ
lines.style: Strategic, forward-thinking. Delivered with more weight than the previous directives—this is opportunity, not just operation. Slight emphasis on 'strengthen.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新倉庫に商品を格納いたします
lines.en: Yes. We'll move the inventory into the new warehouse right away.
lines.style: Final, assured closure. Calm and efficient. The slight warmth of someone wrapping up—this conversation is done. He knows what's next.
